newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Asia Naphtha/Mogas - Gasoline shored up by firm deal.
newsitem.headline: Asia Naphtha/Mogas - Gasoline shored up by firm deal.

text.p: Gasoline traders shored up prices on Wednesday while naphtha staged a late day recovery from earlier losses, traders said.

A Dutch trader offering 50,000 barrels of 95-octane unleaded gasoline on Tuesday improved the offer by 5 cents to $27.10 per barrel lifting February 26-March 2. A buyer emerged late in the trading day at the same level and timing and a deal was reported done.
The seller said he only had high octane supplies and was therefore offering the 97-octane and bidding for 92-octane.

A European major was on the opposite stance and bid for 97-octane lifting February 20-24 at $28.00 per barrel fob Singapore, the same level as a Dutch trader's offer for February 25-March 1. On Tuesday, the bid was higher at $28.10 against the offer at $28.00.
The two traders again reversed roles on the 92-octane market at $26.85/$26.90 for February 20-24 and February 25-March 1, respectively. Tuesday's bids/offers were at $26.85/$26.80.
Naphtha prices regained earlier intraday losses as more buyers emerged on the swaps market while sellers vanished.
"With the crude appearing more stable, we are seeing more buyers," said one trader.
Only bids were last heard, at $24.30 for February, $24.00 for March and $23.50 for April. Earlier on Wednesday, February was quoted at $24.20/$24.50 down from Tuesday's $24.35/$24.60.
Physical naphtha talk was thin as traders already started wrapping up for the Lunar New Year and Moslem Eidel-Fitri holidays starting this weekend, with some offices already closed on Thursday.

Traders, looking to March barrels as February has already been committed, assessed the market as balanced with supplies available from Singapore and Malaysia. But sellers did not indicate any selling idea.
Taiwan bought 30,000-tonnes of heavy naphtha for March 11-20 arrival to Kaohsiung at $239-$240 per tonne c-and-f, lower than its last purchase for February 1-15 delivery at $242-$244.
